content:
On 13 March, BUILT CoLAB organised a meeting of CoLABs and CTIs with the aim of establishing a platform for joint collaboration in the areas of digital and sustainable construction.

The event was attended by around 30 representatives from various institutions who, divided into two rooms created around the themes of Sustainability and Digital Transformation, contributed to a design thinking process, responding to challenges previously set by the BUILT CoLAB team.

The results of this process were very rich and diverse, promoting the cross-fertilisation of ideas and the identification of potential joint solutions with the potential to contribute to solving challenges and innovation in the AEC sector.

BUILT CoLAB thus hopes to have taken an initial step towards the creation of a wider network for the discussion of digital and sustainable construction issues, guaranteeing the identification of a set of ideas that can be developed collaboratively.

In case of doubt or for further questions, we can be reached at info@builtcolab.pt.
